name: Ajooni Biotech Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2010, Ajooni Biotech Ltd is a PURE VEG. animal health care solutions company. It is a significant player in the animal feed and aquaculture sectors.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
ABL was incorporated in February 2010 and was promoted by Mr Jasjot Singh (chairman and managing director). It manufactures a variety of compound animal feed such as cattle feed, cattle feed chips, camel feed, cotton oil cake, mustard oil cake and a wide range of feed supplements. Facilities in Khanna, Punjab, have a total installed capacity of 60,000 MTPA.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.87 times its book value
Company is expected to give good quarter
Debtor days have improved from 70.5 to 51.7 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 4.87% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.53 Cr.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -5.52%
